sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Volume grew 11% over Q2 while the on-time rate held above target. Most of the growth came from recurring statement runs.
Two press outages in August cost about four production days. Both were recovered within the quarter.

sections.heading: Volume by product
paragraphs: Statements and invoices remain the largest lines. Book work is seasonal and peaks in Q4.

sections.heading: Next quarter
paragraphs: Priorities: add a second finishing line, move proofs to tagged PDF, and cut reprints below 0.5%.
